sections.title: Pros
sections.narration: Positives first: anthocyanin-rich berry pigments. The red-purple pigment story adds a food-specific antioxidant angle. Exceptional fibre for a fruit. Raspberries are one of the clearest fruit examples where fibre changes the sugar story. Sweet-tart flavour without a huge sugar load. They taste sweet, but the sugar number stays restrained for fruit.

sections.title: Cons
sections.narration: Downsides next: very short shelf life. They spoil quickly, so waste and timing matter. Tiny seeds can bother some people. The seed texture is part of the fruit, but not everyone likes it. Price swings hard out of season. Fresh raspberries can become expensive compared with sturdier fruit.
